text:
leo_collections: Heads up — Cedar Supply (acct CDR-4521) missed payment for invoice #4521 ($28,750) due 2026-03-15. ACH R01 on 2026-03-16. They reached out asking for a 3-month installment plan. Reposting here for approvals and next steps. @maria_fin @jamal_sales

billing-bot: Automated alert: payment failure detected (ACH R01) on 2026-03-16 for invoice 4521 — $28,750.

maria_fin: Can we do a 3-mo split? What's the exposure if they default again? Need a signed payment agreement + proof of first payment before we remove from collections.

leo_collections: Proposed options from my convo w/ client:
- Option A: 3 equal payments (3 x $9,583.33)
- Option B: 3 payments with 2% admin fee applied to total (customer prefers this so we secure some cost recovery)
Customer says they can wire the first payment next week. They asked for a secure payment link too.

sylvia-cs: They're telling the same story on the account health call — delayed receivables. Willing to sign an addendum. I can attach their statement once they DM it.

jamal_sales: Please don't escalate to legal yet. Cedar is a high-touch account and we're onboarding a new integration this quarter. Sales wants to keep them alive. If finance needs tighter guardrails we can require first payment proof + PO.

maria_fin: OK — I will approve a conditional 3-mo plan if: 1) customer signs the addendum referencing invoice 4521, 2) first payment posted by 2026-03-25, and 3) they accept the 2% admin fee. If those are met, we will stop dunning and remove the account from the weekly escalation list.

leo_collections: I'll prepare the addendum and payment link. Drafted terms: first payment due on receipt, then two monthly payments on 2026-04-24 and 2026-05-24. Will include bank wire instructions + card link fallback. Tagging @legal-ops for a quick review of the addendum.

legal-ops: I can do a short addendum. Need invoice snapshot, order ID, and the exact language re: admin fee. Send it here and I'll return redlines within 24 hours.

leo_collections: Pushed addendum draft to shared drive and DM'ed the customer. Sent secure paylink via email. Notified them: sign + wire first payment by 3/25.

billing-bot: Payment monitor: awaiting first payment for invoice 4521.

leo_collections: Customer sent proof of outgoing wire this morning (SWIFT/ACH reference attached in DM). Asking finance to confirm when funds land.

billing-bot: Payment update: incoming wire $10,000 for invoice 4521 — received at 2026-03-24 15:12 UTC. Applied to invoice. Remaining balance: $18,750. Transaction ID TX-2026-0312-8877. :white_check_mark:

leo_collections: Confirmed receipt. I updated the payment plan: first installment $10,000 applied, remaining two payments 2026-04-24 $9,375 and 2026-05-24 $9,375 (2% admin fee was rolled into schedule). I've attached the signed addendum.

maria_fin: Good — mark as "pending plan" and remove from active dunning list. Keep me posted after April payment. Also please add a memo to the ledger for the admin fee and reserve a small allowance in the doubtful accounts bucket.

jamal_sales: Thanks team — appreciate the flexibility. Will loop Cedar's finance contact on the timeline and escalate internally if they ask for extended terms.

legal-ops: Received signed addendum, no redlines. We won't escalate to collections if the agreed schedule is met.

leo_collections: Closing thread — moved account out of automated dunning and set reminders for 04/24 and 05/24. I'll post another update after next payment. :eyes:

billing-bot: Reminder scheduled: next payment due 2026-04-24 for invoice 4521 — $9,375.
